release.md
Deploy migration 002_up.sql first, then replace application instances one at a time. Old and new instances share the database during rollout. Rollback restarts the old binary first, then runs 002_down.sql. Staging has not run this release.

001_initial.sql
CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL);

002_up.sql
ALTER TABLE users RENAME COLUMN name TO display_name;

002_down.sql

old_reader.py

/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short; python3 - <<'PY'
import ast
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3

files = [Path(p) for p in ('release.md', '001_initial.sql', '002_up.sql', '002_down.sql', 'old_reader.py', 'new_reader.py')]
before = {str(p): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files}
queries = {}
for name in ('old_reader.py', 'new_reader.py'):
    module = ast.parse(Path(name).read_text())
    assignment, = module.body
    assert isinstance(assignment, ast.Assign) and assignment.targets[0].id == 'QUERY'
    queries[name] = ast.literal_eval(assignment.value)

conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
print('SQLite version:', sqlite3.sqlite_version)
def inspect(label):
    print('\\nSTATE:', label)
    print('schema:', conn.execute(\"SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='users'\").fetchone()[0])
    print('stored rows:', conn.execute('SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY id').fetchall())
    for reader, query in queries.items():
        try:
            print(reader, repr(query), 'OK:', conn.execute(query).fetchall())
        except sqlite3.Error as exc:
            print(reader, repr(query), 'ERROR:', type(exc).__name__, str(exc))

conn.executescript(Path('001_initial.sql').read_text())
conn.executemany('INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)', [(1, 'Original name'), (2, 'Unchanged name')])
conn.commit()
inspect('initial, with representative existing rows')
conn.executescript(Path('002_up.sql').read_text())
inspect('up, before new-schema writes')
print('\\nSynthetic new-schema writes (not application-writer evidence):')
print(\"UPDATE users SET display_name='Updated after up' WHERE id=1\")
conn.execute('UPDATE users SET display_name=? WHERE id=?', ('Updated after up', 1))
print(\"INSERT INTO users (id, display_name) VALUES (3, 'Inserted after up')\")
conn.execute('INSERT INTO users (id, display_name) VALUES (?, ?)', (3, 'Inserted after up'))
conn.commit()
inspect('up, after committed new-schema insert/update; also old-binary-first rollback window')
expected = [(1, 'Updated after up'), (2, 'Unchanged name'), (3, 'Inserted after up')]
assert conn.execute('SELECT id, display_name FROM users ORDER BY id').fetchall() == expected
conn.executescript(Path('002_down.sql').read_text())
inspect('down, after rollback')
assert conn.execute('SELECT id, name FROM users ORDER BY id').fetchall() == expected
print('\\nPASS: updated, untouched, and newly inserted rows survive down with values intact')
print('integrity_check:', conn.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0])
after = {str(p): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files}
assert before == after
print('PASS: SHA-256 unchanged for all six release files')
PY"
